**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES** at `96f9f41a676e2d41868245715c719f589b757fb8`.

Delta-only review from passed `b56a990`, output `32ef4af52214506aa8024002c66b579a96e3fc6b`. This changes plain CLI formatting and the existing API view's legacy-command construction, not its authority, scheduling or mutation paths.

**CLI cost:** project/prime/role/holder/legacy/output fields now pass the existing closed renderers. The new machine predicate checks at most 64 bytes for accepted values. `shown(...).into_owned()` produces a String where the old `text(...)` helper already did; direct borrowed render paths avoid that allocation. Latest-output heads now validate up to 40 bytes before displaying seven, but avoid the old temporary `chars().take(7).collect()` String.

The inherited P185-N001 qualification remains: invalid values call full-input `chars().count()`, so malformed large fields are not constant-time. CLI work scales with displayed rows/fields and those raw lengths. Existing JSON parsing/list cloning and raw `--json` identity sizes are not newly capped.

**API cost:** each already-selected open/end-pending legacy prime row gets bounded seat64/name32 checks. The release-command builder is lazy and skipped for unprintable keys, emitting null instead. This can save command allocation; it adds no store/network query, actual release, delivery, process launch, writer commit, poll or timer. The CLI prints the raw-key guidance when command is null. All work is on an existing view invocation, not a new fleet tick.

**Exact-head CI:** [42487751672](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42487751672), successful Rust job `128753240980`, upload artifact **13620009099**: **2,252 executed cases passed**, zero failures/errors, five separately skipped. Verified the full-rendered-text CLI unit case and extended real-store HTTP legacy-row case, plus all six spawn guards. Rust lint, Node22/24 and replacement delivers checks succeed. The CLI case checks the complete formatter result, not a new local subprocess stdout capture; author U1-U8 mutations were not rerun.

Detached worktree/GitHub final heads agree, clean and CLEAN. No local build, test, mutation, live CLI view or performance probe. Prior scan/fence notes remain; new-head correctness/security verdicts are independent.
